script.title: THE JAMMED MACHINE
script.scene_zh: 深夜便利商店 · 反映販賣機故障
script.story_hook: A trucker, a stuck snack, and one very late night.
script.intro_zh: 一位貨車司機、一袋卡住的零食，和一個很晚的夜。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back! Tonight we hear a vending machine mix-up. Listen from the stuck snack to the refund.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來！今晚我們會聽到一整段自動販賣機的烏龍事件，從零食卡住到申請退款。
script.outro: That's how a stuck snack gets fixed. Listen again and shadow the refund lines.
script.outro_zh: 卡住的零食就這樣解決了。再聽一遍，跟著唸退款那幾句。
script.practice_intro_en: Ready to repeat? Say each line after the speaker.
script.practice_intro_zh: 準備好跟讀了嗎？跟著每一位說話者唸一遍。
script.char_a_description: a middle-aged man in his early forties with a shaved head and light stubble, wearing a faded red flannel shirt over a white tee, dark work boots, broad shoulders, tired but warm brown eyes, holding a payment phone.
script.char_b_description: a young woman in her early twenties with shoulder-length chestnut hair under a green store cap, wearing a striped polo shirt and a name badge, average build, quick friendly smile, standing behind the counter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, your machine ate my chips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi jʊr məˈʃin ɛt maɪ ʧɪps/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，你們的機器吃掉我的洋芋片了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no. Which one, E7?
dialogue.zh: 噢，不會吧。哪一台，E7 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the one. I pushed B4 twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ði wʌn aɪ pʊʃt bi fɔr dwaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 就是那台。我按了 B4 兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did the bag drop but get stuck?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə bæg drɑp bʌt ɡɛt stʌk/
dialogue.zh: 袋子掉下去了，但卡住了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's hanging by one corner.
dialogue.zh: 它只有一角還掛在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I see a receipt?
dialogue.zh: 可以給我看看收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, I paid with my phone.
dialogue.zh: 呃，我是用手機付錢的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the screen here.
dialogue.zh: 我查一下這裡的螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it show my sale?
dialogue.zh: 上面有顯示我那筆交易嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes... one fifty just went through.
dialogue.zh: 有……一元五角剛扣成功了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it took my money already?
dialogue.zh: 所以它已經收走我的錢了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That cash stays inside the machine.
dialogue.zh: 那筆現金還留在機器裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can't you open it with a key?
dialogue.phonetic: /kænt ju ˈoʊpən ɪt wɪθ ə ki/
dialogue.zh: 你們不能用鑰匙打開它嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I would, but the key is missing.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd bʌt ðə ki ɪz ˈmɪsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我也想開，可是鑰匙不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Missing? How long has it been like that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪsɪŋ haʊ lɔŋ həz ɪt bɪn laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 不見了？這樣多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Since Tuesday, honestly. I'm so sorry.
dialogue.zh: 誠實說，從星期二就那樣了。真的很抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I drove eight hours today.
dialogue.zh: 唉，我今天開了八小時的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I believe you. Long haul?
dialogue.zh: 我相信你。跑長途的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve years of long hauls, friend.
dialogue.zh: 我跑長途已經十二年了，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow. Okay, let me call the company.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ oʊˈkeɪ lɛt mi kɔl ðə ˈkʌmpəni/
dialogue.zh: 哇。好，讓我打電話給總公司。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do. What do they need?
dialogue.zh: 麻煩你了。他們需要什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last digits of your phone number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst ˈdɪdʒəts ʌv jʊr foʊn ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 你手機號碼最後幾碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It ends in seven, three, two, zero.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɛndz ɪn ˈsɛvən θri tu ˈzɪroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 尾碼是七、三、二、零。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks. One minute while I call.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。等我一分鐘，我打過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time. My back aches anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊr taɪm maɪ bæk eɪks ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來。我反正背也在痠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, sit down while you wait.
dialogue.zh: 來，趁等待的時候先坐一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're kind. Coffee? I have a spare cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr kaɪnd ˈkɔfi aɪ həv ə spɛr kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 你人真好。咖啡嗎？我還多一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe later! For now, please sit.
dialogue.zh: 也許等等再說！先請坐吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Night driving is rough, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks naɪt ˈdraɪvɪŋ ɪz rʌf ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。開夜車很辛苦，你知道的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hear you. My shift ends at two.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr ju maɪ ʃɪft ɛndz ət tu/
dialogue.zh: 我懂。我的班到凌晨兩點才下班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two a.m.? That's rough on you.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu eɪ ˈɛm ðæts rʌf ɑn ju/
dialogue.zh: 凌晨兩點？那對你很辛苦耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's fine. I love the quiet nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪn aɪ lʌv ðə ˈkwaɪət naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。我喜歡安靜的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Same here. Hey, is machine E4 okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæ seɪm hɪr heɪ ɪz məˈʃin i fɔr oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！我也是。對了，E4 那台正常嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: E4 works great. Upstairs, first left.
dialogue.phonetic: /i fɔr wɝks ɡreɪt ˈʌpˌstɛrz fɝst lɛft/
dialogue.zh: E4 運作正常。樓上，左轉第一間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe my peanuts live up there.
dialogue.zh: 說不定我的花生在那上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peanuts? That's my snack too.
dialogue.zh: 花生？那也是我最愛的零食。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee and peanuts. That's my whole dinner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi ænd ˈpinəts ðæts maɪ hoʊl ˈdɪnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡加花生。那就是我的一整頓晚餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, my manager's on the phone now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ maɪ ˈmænədz ɑn ðə foʊn naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我經理現在在電話上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good news or bad news?
dialogue.zh: 好消息還是壞消息？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good! They'll refund today's charge.
dialogue.zh: 好消息！他們會退今天那筆款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a code or a number?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə koʊd ɔr ə ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我需要代碼還是專線號碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, call the refund line: 800-555-0116.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kɔl ðə ˈridʌnf laɪn eɪt ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɪv faɪv ˈfɪv ˈoʊ wʌn wʌn sɪks/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you write that down for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən ju raɪt ðæt daʊn fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我寫下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, right on this paper bag.
dialogue.zh: 當然，就寫在這張紙袋上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. When does the money come back?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt wɛn dʊz ðə ˈmʌni kʌm bæk/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。錢什麼時候會退回來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A few days, maybe three.
dialogue.zh: 幾天吧，也許三天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fine. I can wait.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。我等得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just don't trust E7 for chips yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst doʊnt trʌst i sɛvən fɔr ʧɪps jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 只是先別再相信 E7 的洋芋片了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Good tip. I'll remember that.
dialogue.zh: 哈！好忠告。我會記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want a granola bar instead? On us.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt ə ɡrəˈnoʊlə bɑr ɪnˈstɛd ɑn ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 要不要換一根穀物棒？我們請客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You don't have to... but yes, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju doʊnt həv tu bʌt jɛs pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 不用這麼客氣……但好的，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's chocolate. Hope you like it.
dialogue.zh: 是巧克力口味的。希望你會喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. This coffee is yours now.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。這杯咖啡現在是你的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Deal. Drive safe out there.
dialogue.zh: 哈！成交。路上開車注意安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. You made a bad night better.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ju meɪd ə bæd naɪt ˈbɛtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。你讓我這個糟糕的夜晚好過多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aw, that's just my job.
dialogue.zh: 哎，這只是我的工作啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday you fix E7, right?
dialogue.zh: 星期五你們會修好 E7，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First thing in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 一早第一件事就是修它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll return for my chips!
dialogue.zh: 那我會回來拿我的洋芋片！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll save you a bag next Friday. Bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /wil seɪv ju ə bæɡ nɛkst ˈfraɪdeɪ baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 下週五我們幫你留一包。再見！

script.youtube_title_en: "Your Machine Ate My Chips" — Refund Trouble at a Broken Vending Machine
script.youtube_description:
60句自動販賣機故障真實對話，聽完就能自己反映問題、問退款、要到專線號碼！

這一集走進深夜的便利商店。一位開了八小時車的貨車司機，零食掉進機器卻卡住，手機扣款成功了，店員一步步幫他打電話給總公司、登記退款、拿到專線號碼，最後還收到請客的穀物棒。

你會練到：
- 反映機器吃零食：「Excuse me, your machine ate my chips.」
- 詢問扣款紀錄：「Does it show my sale?」
- 請求退款與記號碼：「Do I need a code or a number?」
- 禮貌請客與道謝：「On us.」「Drive safe out there.」

後半段為逐句聽力與跟讀練習，建議先聽兩遍，再一句一句跟著唸。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

喜歡這集請訂閱、按讚並開啟小鈴鐺，每天一段英文對話陪你練習！

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of real broken-vending-machine English you can hear and use tonight.

In this episode, a tired trucker's snack gets stuck in machine E7, and his phone payment already went through. Listen as the clerk calls the company, gets a refund promise, writes down the refund line, and even saves the night with a free granola bar.

You will practice:
- Reporting the problem: Excuse me, your machine ate my chips.
- Checking the payment: Does it show my sale?
- Asking about refunds: Do I need a code or a number?
- Polite small talk: Drive safe out there.

The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing practice. Listen twice, then repeat every line out loud.

Great for A2 learners: no memorizing needed, just listen and you will start using it.

If you enjoy this lesson, subscribe, like, and turn on notifications for a daily English dialogue!

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish

零食掉進販賣機卡住了，錢卻扣了怎麼辦？🥔 店員沒鑰匙也能幫你退款嗎？退款專線又是什麼？

這一集帶大家走進深夜的便利商店，看一位貨車司機如何反映機器吃零食、查出扣款紀錄，並跟店員一起打通退款電話。

你會聽到：
🍫 反映問題——「Excuse me, your machine ate my chips.」一句話說清狀況。
📲 查扣款紀錄——「Does it show my sale?」確認錢到底扣了沒有。
🗒 登記退款——「Do I need a code or a number?」拿到專線號碼800-555-0116。
